card.name: Overdose and poison control wording
card.fires_on: Words in overdose and warning passages: the "a" after "contact" or "consult" before Poison Control Center, "treated" after "not immediately recognized and", and "Treatment" opening an overdose sentence.

modes.label: Poison control referral
modes.description: The word "a" right after "contact" or "consult" before Poison Control Center in overdose sections.
modes.example: it is advisable to contact<< a>> poison control center to obtain the latest recommendations

modes.label: Recognized and treated
modes.description: "treated" or "Treatment" in phrases about respiratory depression or overdose management.
modes.example: Respiratory depression, if not immediately recognized and<< treated>>, may lead to respiratory arrest and death

modes.label: Inside thrombotic
modes.description: The middle piece of the word thrombotic in cardiovascular event warnings.
